chunks: And the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم said:
"Trim the mustaches, let the beards grow, and do not resemble the Jews."
ai.seo_question: What did the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم say about trimming the mustache and growing the beard?
ai.summary: This hadith instructs believers regarding personal grooming by trimming the mustache and allowing the beard to grow. It also frames this practice as part of maintaining a distinct religious appearance and avoiding imitation of another community.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.329 - The Messenger of Allah (sw) said:
"Trim your mustaches and let your beards grow, and do not resemble the Jews."
